title: Mauritius Family Holiday
headline: One resort, a lagoon and days that can stay empty.
description: Six nights in Mauritius for families: a single resort stay with a kids’ club or a proper pool, and one island day if you want it.
image_alt: Clear lagoon water over a coral reef
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room configuration, child ages, meal plan and whether a park or island day is included. International flights sit outside this figure unless you ask us to ticket them.
overview: A family island week with one check-in. We shortlist resorts that actually work for children — beach entry, pool, connecting rooms — then add at most one organised day so the rest can stay empty.
highlights: Six nights in one family resort.
Connecting or family rooms requested where possible.
Optional Île aux Cerfs or Casela day as quoted.
why: No hotel-hopping with children and luggage.
Daily load can be cut to the pool and beach.
Meal plans can include children as the resort prices them.
inclusions: Resort stay on the agreed meal plan
Accommodation on family-room sharing as quoted
exclusions: Park tickets, extra boat days and spa unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

notes: Resort, room type and any park day are confirmed only after you approve the written quote. Boat days depend on weather. An inquiry is not a booking.
